citation.title: Retrospective Review of Transpulmonary Pressure Guided Positive End-Expiratory Pressure Titration for Mechanical Ventilation in Class II and III Obesity

provenance.quote: All adult patients 18 years old or older requiring mechanical ventilation with class II and III obesity (BMI ≥ 35 kg/m2) with ARDS were eligible.
Twenty-nine mechanically ventilated adult patients with a median BMI of 45.8 kg/m2 with acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS).
SETTING: Intensive care unit in a community based hospital system in Newark, Delaware.
PEEP was titrated based on PL at end expiration (End Exp PL) until it approached 0 (±2) cm H2O to minimize atelectasis.
Outcomes measured include PEEP, oxygenation, and driving pressure (DP) before and after esophageal manometry at 4 and 24 hr.

method_verbatim.value: Estimating PL, defined as (PL = airway pressure − pleural pressure)

provenance.quote: Estimating PL, defined as (PL = airway pressure − pleural pressure), may be more accurate in obesity than the traditional use of PPLAT as a surrogate.

strategy_verbatim.value: PEEP was titrated based on PL at end expiration (End Exp PL) until it approached 0 (±2) cm H2O to minimize atelectasis. The upper limit for safety to prevent overdistension and barotrauma was met if PL is greater than 20 cm H2O at end inspiration (End Insp PL) via an inspiratory hold maneuver. If this occurred, PEEP or tidal volume would be subsequently decreased until End Insp PL was less than 20 cm H2O

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: obese_population: enrolment required BMI ≥ 35 kg/m2 and median BMI 45.8 kg/m2. timing_subgroup mixed: 16 balloons within first day of mechanical ventilation, 7 between days 1 and 10, 4 after day 10. ptp_target_subgroups: end-expiratory PL titrated to 0 (±2) cm H2O (absolute_zero_end_expiratory_ptp) plus an end-inspiratory PL safety limit of 20 cm H2O, which has no dedicated enum value and is coded 'other'. Mortality not evaluated in this study, so no is_longest_reported_mortality entry exists.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap with any COHORTS.md cluster. Single centre Christiana Care, Newark, DE, USA; enrolment December 09, 2019 to January 31, 2021; no trial registration reported. Does not match epvent1/epvent2 (Talmor/Beitler, NCT00127491 and EPVent-2), mannheim_boesing, mgh_lung_rescue, or angers clusters by centre, dates, or population.
unclear_items: countries: inferred from 'Newark, Delaware' and Christiana Care institutional affiliations; the paper does not state 'United States' explicitly.
balloon_calibration.method: coded not_reported; insertion and filling details are in Appendix 1 (http://links.lww.com/CCX/A981), which was not provided with the article.
feasibility.n_placement_successful: the paper says 48 balloons were 'placed' but does not explicitly state all placements were technically successful; coded 48 from that wording.

feasibility.balloon_related_complications: pneumomediastinum is listed as an adverse event after PL-guided optimization but the paper does not attribute it specifically to the balloon versus high PEEP ventilation; recorded here and flagged for adjudication.

outcomes: PEEP, FiO2, S/F ratio, and driving pressure are each reported at three timepoints (Before, After 4 hr, After 24 hr) with paired Wilcoxon tests between consecutive timepoints only; no baseline-vs-24hr contrast is reported.
design.comparison_structure: coded within_patient_crossover (same patients before and after PL-guided titration) although the paper calls itself a retrospective cohort study.
timing.reference_event: coded intubation based on 'days of mechanical ventilation prior to balloon insert'; the paper does not name the reference event explicitly.
data_only_in_figure: Figure 1: per-patient PEEP and plateau pressure at 4-hr postballoon insertion (26 patients shown; plateau pressure not obtained in three patients).
Figure 2: per-patient PEEP set by ARDSNet high PEEP table versus esophageal manometry at 4-hr postballoon insertion (29 patients).
extraction_flags.general_notes: Mortality was not evaluated ('Although our study did not evaluate mortality...'). The comparison against the ARDSNet high PEEP table is a hypothetical per-patient comparison of set PEEP, not a delivered comparator strategy. Vasopressor dose changes reported as average increases with SD: norepinephrine 0.05 (± 0.04) µg/kg/min at 4 hr and 0.10 (± 0.09) at 24 hr; epinephrine 0.02 (± 0.01) at 4 hr and 0.01 (± 0.01) at 24 hr; baseline norepinephrine 0.07 (± 0.14), epinephrine 0.01 (± 0.02) µg/kg/min. No dedicated schema field for these vasopressor dose changes; recorded here. Appendix 1 (titration/insertion protocol) not available.
